# Complex_Network_Topology

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
The study of network structures beyond regular lattices, including scale-free, small-world, and random graphs, affecting dynamical processes. Determines how perturbations and information spread in neuromorphic and computing networks, influencing robustness and efficiency of TCC/iNEST designs.
